note: Area 3a, fundus of the central sulcus (Zilles 2017 Methods: primary somatosensory cortex, Geyer et al. 1999 / Grefkes et al. 2001). Postcentral gyrus lies within the Heiss 1985 sensorimotor region; Chugani 1987 'Sensorimotor cortex' is the same gyral pair.

Area 3b, posterior bank of the central sulcus (Zilles 2017 Methods: primary somatosensory cortex, Geyer et al. 1999 / Grefkes et al. 2001). Postcentral gyrus lies within the Heiss 1985 sensorimotor region; Chugani 1987 'Sensorimotor cortex' is the same gyral pair.

Area 1, crown of the postcentral gyrus (Zilles 2017 Methods: primary somatosensory cortex, Geyer et al. 1999 / Grefkes et al. 2001). Postcentral gyrus lies within the Heiss 1985 sensorimotor region; Chugani 1987 'Sensorimotor cortex' is the same gyral pair.

Area 2, posterior postcentral gyrus (Zilles 2017 Methods: primary somatosensory cortex, Geyer et al. 1999 / Grefkes et al. 2001). Postcentral gyrus lies within the Heiss 1985 sensorimotor region; Chugani 1987 'Sensorimotor cortex' is the same gyral pair.
Primary motor cortex, precentral gyrus / anterior bank of central sulcus (Zilles 2017 Methods: Brodmann 1909). Within the Heiss 1985 sensorimotor region; Chugani 1987 'Sensorimotor cortex'.

Premotor cortex BA6 (Zilles 2017 Methods: Brodmann 1909). Heiss 1985 'Premotor cortex' is the only candidate; BA6 also extends onto the medial surface (SMA/pre-SMA) and the Zilles 2017 sample location within 6 is not given, so medial sampling would fall outside a lateral PET ROI. Treated as contained.

Isocortical prefrontal area 8 (Zilles 2017 Methods: Brodmann 1909) occupies the posterior superior AND middle frontal gyri. Heiss 1985 has no middle-frontal region, so area 8 is assigned to 'Sup. front. cortex'; the MFG portion is unaccounted for.

Dorsolateral prefrontal area 9 (Brodmann 1909) spans the superior and middle frontal gyri. Assigned to 'Sup. front. cortex' (no middle-frontal region in Heiss 1985); partial because the MFG portion is not covered by this group.

Lateral frontopolar area (Zilles 2017 Figure 1 legend: 10L from Bludau et al. 2014). Heiss 1985 has no frontal-pole region; the pole is the anterior continuation of the superior/middle frontal gyri, so it is assigned to 'Sup. front. cortex'. Alternative considered and rejected: 'Orbital cortex' (10L is not on the orbital surface).

Medial frontopolar area (10M from Bludau et al. 2014). Lies on the medial frontal pole, i.e. the medial face of the superior frontal gyrus, hence 'Sup. front. cortex'. Alternative 'Orbital cortex' rejected: 10M is anterior-medial, above the gyrus rectus, not on the orbital surface. Approximate because a 1985 PET ROI on the medial surface is unlikely to have been drawn separately.
Orbitofrontal area 11 (Brodmann 1909), gyrus rectus / medial orbital gyrus. Within Heiss 1985 'Orbital cortex'.
Area 44, pars opercularis of the inferior frontal gyrus (Amunts et al. 1999). Within Heiss 1985 'Inf. front. cortex' (inferior frontal gyrus).
Area 45, pars triangularis of the inferior frontal gyrus (Amunts et al. 1999). Within 'Inf. front. cortex'.

Mid-dorsolateral prefrontal area 46 (Brodmann 1909) lies mainly on the middle frontal gyrus and the dorsal bank of the inferior frontal sulcus, extending onto the IFG. Heiss 1985 has no middle-frontal region; assigned to 'Inf. front. cortex' following the suggested grouping (IFG-adjacent, same lateral prefrontal PET territory). Alternative 'Sup. front. cortex' considered; neither is a containing region, hence approximate.

Area 47 (Brodmann 1909): pars orbitalis of the inferior frontal gyrus and lateral orbital surface. The IFG part falls in 'Inf. front. cortex'; the lateral orbital part would fall in 'Orbital cortex'. Assigned to inferior frontal; partial.
Primary visual cortex, area 17 / calcarine sulcus (Amunts et al. 2000). = Heiss 1985 'Prim. vis. cortex'; Chugani 1987 'Calcarine cortex'.

Secondary visual cortex, dorsal (cuneal) part of area 18 (Amunts et al. 2000). Peristriate occipital cortex = Heiss 1985 'Vis. assoc. cortex'. Chugani 1987 'Occipital cortex' is listed separately from 'Calcarine cortex' and is taken as extrastriate occipital cortex (approximate match).

Secondary visual cortex, ventral (lingual) part of area 18 (Amunts et al. 2000). Peristriate occipital cortex = Heiss 1985 'Vis. assoc. cortex'. Chugani 1987 'Occipital cortex' is listed separately from 'Calcarine cortex' and is taken as extrastriate occipital cortex (approximate match).
Dorsal V3 (cuneus; Julich hOc3d). Extrastriate occipital cortex within 'Vis. assoc. cortex'. Chugani 'Occipital cortex' approximate (see V2d).
V3A (dorsal cuneus / transverse occipital sulcus; Julich hOc4d). Extrastriate occipital cortex within 'Vis. assoc. cortex'. Chugani 'Occipital cortex' approximate.
Ventral V3 / VP (lingual gyrus; Julich hOc3v). Extrastriate occipital cortex within 'Vis. assoc. cortex'. Chugani 'Occipital cortex' approximate.
Ventral V4 (lingual/fusiform boundary of the occipital lobe; Julich hOc4v). Extrastriate occipital cortex within 'Vis. assoc. cortex'. Chugani 'Occipital cortex' approximate.

Posterior fusiform area FG1 (Caspers et al. 2013), ventral occipito-temporal cortex at the occipital-pole level; Zilles 2017 call FG1/FG2 'hierarchically higher visual areas'. Decision: 'Vis. assoc. cortex' rather than 'Inf. temp. cortex', because FG1/FG2 lie posterior to the temporo-occipital notch in the occipital lobe and are visual by function. heiss2004_anatomy_id keeps the temporal_lobe assignment of s1e_zilles2017_julich_area_map.csv (lobe assignment ambiguous there too). Approximate because 1985 ventral-occipital ROIs could have been lumped with inferior temporal cortex.

Posterior fusiform area FG2 (Caspers et al. 2013), ventral occipito-temporal cortex at the occipital-pole level; Zilles 2017 call FG1/FG2 'hierarchically higher visual areas'. Decision: 'Vis. assoc. cortex' rather than 'Inf. temp. cortex', because FG1/FG2 lie posterior to the temporo-occipital notch in the occipital lobe and are visual by function. heiss2004_anatomy_id keeps the temporal_lobe assignment of s1e_zilles2017_julich_area_map.csv (lobe assignment ambiguous there too). Approximate because 1985 ventral-occipital ROIs could have been lumped with inferior temporal cortex.
Inferior temporal gyrus area 20 (Zilles 2017 Methods: multimodal temporal area, Brodmann 1909). = Heiss 1985 'Inf. temp. cortex'.
Middle temporal gyrus area 21 (multimodal temporal area, Brodmann 1909). = Heiss 1985 'Middle temp. cortex'.

Superior temporal gyrus area 22 (Brodmann 1909). Within Heiss 1985 'Sup. temp. cortex'. No Chugani 1987 counterpart (Chugani's 'Transverse temporal cortex' is Heschl's gyrus only; 'Temporal cortex' is lobe-level).

Primary auditory cortex area 41, Heschl's gyrus, on the dorsal surface of the superior temporal gyrus. At 1985 PET resolution part of 'Sup. temp. cortex'. Chugani 1987 'Transverse temporal cortex' = Heschl's gyrus.

Secondary auditory cortex area 42 (planum temporale / lateral Heschl), dorsal superior temporal gyrus. Within 'Sup. temp. cortex'. Chugani 'Transverse temporal cortex' covers 41 and may include 42 (approximate).

Lateral portion of area 37 (Zilles 2017 Methods: parieto-temporo-occipital region, Brodmann 1909), posterior inferior / middle temporal gyri. Assigned to 'Inf. temp. cortex'; partial because the MTG part belongs to 'Middle temp. cortex'.

Basal portion of area 37, mid-fusiform gyrus (temporal lobe, anterior to FG1/FG2). Decision: 'Inf. temp. cortex' (basal temporal surface, which axial PET ROIs of the inferior temporal level would include) rather than 'Vis. assoc. cortex'. Approximate: no Heiss region is named for the fusiform gyrus.

Medial portion of area 37, medial fusiform / lingual boundary of the posterior temporal lobe. Decision: 'Inf. temp. cortex' together with 37B (Brodmann area 37 is a temporal-lobe area); the alternative 'Vis. assoc. cortex' (lingual side) was considered. Approximate.

Temporal pole area 38 (Zilles 2017 Methods: multimodal temporal area, Brodmann 1909). Heiss 1985 has no temporal-pole region. Decision: 'Inf. limbic struct.' (the temporal pole is paralimbic in Mesulam's scheme and adjoins the uncus/amygdala level where an 'inferior limbic' PET ROI would be drawn) rather than splitting it across the three temporal-gyrus groups. Approximate; alternative = 'Inf. temp. cortex'.

Perirhinal / ectorhinal area 36 (periallocortex of the anterior medial temporal lobe, Brodmann 1909). Decision: 'Inf. limbic struct.' (medial temporal limbic cortex adjacent to entorhinal cortex and amygdala) rather than 'Inf. temp. cortex' or 'Hippocampus'. Approximate: the composition of Heiss' 'inferior limbic structures' ROI is not described in the 1985 paper (regional procedure refers to Heiss 1984).
Periarchicortical anterior cingulate area 24 (Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008/2009). Within 'Cingulate gyrus'. Chugani 1987 'Anterior cingulate cortex'.

Isocortical anterior cingulate area 32 (Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008/2009). Within 'Cingulate gyrus' (paracingulate part may extend onto the medial superior frontal gyrus). Chugani 1987 'Anterior cingulate cortex'.
Posterior cingulate area 23 (Brodmann 1909). Within 'Cingulate gyrus'. Chugani 1987 has only an anterior cingulate row, so NA.
Posterior cingulate / precuneal area 31 (Brodmann 1909); its dorsal part lies on the precuneus. Assigned to 'Cingulate gyrus'; partial. No Chugani counterpart.
Inferior parietal area PFt, anterior supramarginal gyrus (Caspers et al. 2006). Within Heiss 1985 'Inf. par. cortex'.
Inferior parietal area PFm, posterior supramarginal gyrus (Caspers et al. 2006). Within Heiss 1985 'Inf. par. cortex'.
Inferior parietal area PGa, anterior angular gyrus (Caspers et al. 2006). Within Heiss 1985 'Inf. par. cortex'.
Inferior parietal area PGp, posterior angular gyrus (Caspers et al. 2006). Within Heiss 1985 'Inf. par. cortex'.
Area 5L, lateral superior parietal lobule (Scheperjans et al. 2008). Within 'Sup. par. cortex'.

Area 5M, medial superior parietal lobule / anterior precuneus (Scheperjans et al. 2008). Assigned to 'Sup. par. cortex'; partial because a lateral-convexity PET ROI may not include the medial surface.
